source.title: Turnover in services, monthly data (sts_setu_m), weighted by Enterprises by detailed NACE Rev. 2 activity (sbs_ovw_act)
source.table: worked out by Margin Atlas from business/eurostat-sts-turnover-month.json and business/eurostat-sbs-2023.json (scripts/eu_season_estimate.py)

rows.officialClass: NACE Rev. 2 I56: Food and beverage service activities
rows.measure: estimate: the month's sales against the year's average month, 2025-01
rows.note: An estimate: 26 members' own indexes, each over its own average month of 2025, averaged month by month and weighted by its restaurants' 2023 sales; together they hold 98.3% of the EU restaurants' sales. Left out (no twelve months of 2025, or no sales figure): Ireland. The index counts restaurants, cafes and bars together (division 56: no class below it is published monthly).
